messages.subject: Richard | GCC Executive Leadership Profile | Government Relations, ESG & Country Strategy
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Guest,

I am sharing my profile for senior GCC and international leadership mandates involving country strategy, government relations, ESG, corporate affairs and complex stakeholder management.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My current remit spans senior government and regulatory engagement, ESG and social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships, compliance coordination and executive communications within a major multinational mining operation.

Your regional leadership across APAC and the Middle East, together with your work advising major corporates, sovereign wealth funds, family businesses and boards, makes this a relevant introduction.

I am pursuing Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director, Country Representative and VP-track roles across External Affairs, Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG, Strategic Partnerships and related leadership functions. Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority, followed by the UAE and wider region.

I have attached a GCC-focused executive CV. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
